request: an SVG animation of a pelican riding a bike
thesis: A pelican's huge pouched bill, stubby legs and wide body are absurdly wrong for a bicycle, and the animation is funny and readable because the pedalling, wheel spin and bill bob all obey real mechanics.
job: open the page and see a pelican on a bike at once
watch it ride in a seamless loop
see wheels, pedals, legs, bill, scenery all moving in sync
use a control (pause/play, speed) and see state change
tell at a glance it is a pelican and a bicycle

principles: loop must be seamless: end state equals start state
one master clock drives all parts
steps: drive pedal angle from one time value
derive leg angles by two-bone IK from pedal position
tricks: compute legs with IK in JS so feet stay on pedals
scroll background by wheel speed so wheels do not slip
counter-rotate pedals to keep them level
tests: feet stay on pedals every frame
wheel spoke rotation matches ground scroll

tricks: bill bobs a beat behind body

parts: bicycle: two wheels, spokes, frame, fork, saddle, handlebar, chain ring, cranks, pedals

kinds.name: side-view scrolling road ride
kinds.what: classic side profile, scenery scrolls past

descriptions: bill about 1/3 body length with hooked tip
behaviors: pedal turn drives bobbing of body
pause button toggles label and freezes clock
speed slider scales cadence and scroll

checks: pause button changes label and freezes motion
